title: Let Rayalaseema be known for development, not drought, says Pawan Kalyan
description: Three-phase Horticulture Hub plan will benefit around 9.6 lakh farmers, and create 9 lakh acres of new ayacut besides stabilising another 4.3 lakh acres, says Deputy CM; the idea emerged during his Yuva Galam Padayatra and interactions with farmers in Rayalaseema, says Lokesh
